mapping_purpose: Documents the complete HTTP→Code execution path for chat messages, showing exactly where Pi canary shadow evaluation occurs

code_execution_chain.action: Request received, user authenticated, session resolved
Dispatches to appropriate handler based on intent detection
Checks agent_executor_mode == 'pi_compatible_shadow'. If true AND query matches _OFFICIAL_REPORT_PDF_SHADOW_PATTERN, schedules async Pi shadow task.
code_execution_chain.pattern: r'pdf|PDF|官方.{0,6}(链接|原文|PDF|pdf)|年报|年度报告|中报|半年报|季报|一季报|三季报|这份报告|那份报告|报告原文|报告.*在哪'

code_execution_chain.action: Computes stable_bucket(env, agent_id, anon_user_key, salt) → SHA256 → [0,9999]. Selects if bucket < rollout_percent * 100.
Legacy path always executes and returns response to user. Pi shadow is fire-and-forget (asyncio.create_task).
Runs async. enabled() checks triad: mode + shadow_enabled + allowed_agents. Executes official_report_pdf_pi_v1 agent.
Appends JSONL record to pi_agent_shadow_diagnostics_path. Writes per-run JSON to .runs/{run_id}.json atomically.

pi_violation_definition: Pi content appearing in user-visible answer field
p126_gap: P1.26 X1-X10 used GET /health, /profile, /watchlist — none passed through step 2 (ChatOrchestrator). Zero shadow evaluations occurred.
